scope: One operator-directed fast-forward push of main to the canonical Radicle repository and to its GitHub projection, the read-backs, two anonymous clones, one credential-isolated quick start and launch-document updates. Not a tag, release, announcement, force push, governance change or workspace-repository push
owner: The operator owns publication authority and the signing key; Kiln maintainers own the launch kit and this record

authority.source: operator instruction in the working session, given after the close-out report listed publication as an owner action
authority.reading: the repository's routine publication of main to remote rad and then remote github; nothing wider
not_read_as: a push of the workspace repository's catalog commit

pre_push_scan.input: added lines of git diff 428d03fc..bd5edde8: 9081 lines in 115 files; no binary file
patterns: GitHub, GitLab, Slack, AWS and OpenAI-style token shapes
quoted password, secret, token or API-key assignments
tailnet names and private IPv4 addresses
pre_push_scan.positive_control: five synthetic lines; each pattern group matched its line
pre_push_scan.bound: a pattern search over added lines, not a redacting scan of the tree or its history and not privacy clearance

not_exercised: The Nix gates on the published head: they ran on local revisions before publication
The two runtime workspaces from a fresh checkout; their pinned source host returned HTTP 530 earlier the same day
The quick start through the Garden clone; it holds the same tree as the GitHub clone that was built
A refused non-fast-forward push or deletion against the projection's ruleset
A redacting secret scan of the tree and its reachable history
non_claims: Matching references show the observed revision on the observed routes at the observed time; they do not show future availability or source correctness
A passing quick start on one host does not establish production readiness, isolation or release eligibility
A pattern scan with no match is not privacy clearance, and published history cannot be assumed removable
Publication of main is not the 0.1.0 release; onix_release_ready is false
